parameters.name: ClassicExpiredDays
parameters.description: Specifies the retention period of the classic network endpoint. Unit: days.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance.

parameters.name: RetainClassic
parameters.description: Specifies whether to retain the classic network endpoint.

parameters.name: SrcInstanceNetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance. Valid values:

*   vpc: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
*   classic: classic network

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds update-instance-network --drds-instance-id drds000000 --src-instance-network-type classic --retain-classic true --classic-expired-days 30 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds UpdateInstanceNetwork --region cn-hangzhou --RetainClassic true --DrdsInstanceId drds000000 --ClassicExpiredDays 30 --SrcInstanceNetworkType classic
